subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage gap and bridge-letter playbook for FinOptics onboarding
messages:
From: Jane Porter <jane.porter@finoptics.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finoptics.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report and audit window confirmation — FinOptics onboarding

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick answers during today's call. Procurement needs a SOC 2 Type II report that covers our desired contract period. Specifically we need either:

- A SOC 2 Type II report that includes the audit window covering 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30, or
- A signed bridge letter / interim attestation plus evidence that allows our InfoSec team to accept onboarding before the final Type II is issued.

We are aiming to sign by 2027-06-14 to hit our Q3 rollout. If Redwood cannot provide the Type II by then, can you provide a bridge letter and a list of evidence items we can review?

Attached: FinOptics_RFP_SecurityChecklist.xlsx (procurement checklist, stub)

Appreciate your fast turnaround given the timeline.

Best,
Jane Porter
Head of Procurement, FinOptics
jane.porter@finoptics.com
+1 415 555 0123
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: jane.porter@finoptics.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report and audit window confirmation — FinOptics onboarding

Forwarding Jane's request — this is time-sensitive, FinOptics needs either a Type II that covers 2026-07-01 -> 2027-06-30 or a bridge letter + evidence so they can sign by 2027-06-14.

Quick plan I propose (please confirm):
1) Security (Vivek) drafts bridge letter explaining coverage gap and compensating controls — target: 24h draft.
2) Security/Infra collects minimal evidence bundle (access logs, change management, incident response logs, pen test summary) — target: 48h.
3) Sales (Marissa/Laura) prepare mutual action plan and negotiation position (credit / SLA concession if needed) — target: 48h.
4) Legal to review final bridge letter and sign — target: 72h.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_pending_sections.xlsx (internal stub listing which controls/evidence are outstanding), bridge_letter_draft_v1.pdf (starter draft)

Marissa — please prioritize; FinOptics is on the critical path for RDW-8741. Vivek — can you confirm the exact audit period our last Type II covers and whether a bridge is appropriate?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jane.porter@finoptics.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report and audit window confirmation — FinOptics onboarding

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 3:22 PM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Forwarding Jane's request — this is time-sensitive...

Actionable summary from Security:
- Current published SOC 2 Type II: period covered 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31 (filed with auditor). That does NOT fully cover FinOptics' requested window (2026-07-01 -> 2027-06-30).
- Recommended short-term path: provide a bridge letter that: (a) acknowledges the audit coverage gap, (b) lists the compensating controls and continuous evidence we can supply for the uncovered months (2027-01-01 -> 2027-06-30), and (c) commits to providing the next Type II once finalized.

Evidence we can realistically produce within 48 hours (please pull and upload to shared drive):
- Access logs for production control plane (2027-01 to 2027-05) — redacted PII
- Change management tickets and approvals for service changes touching control plane (2027-01 to 2027-05)
- Incident response summary for open/closed incidents in 2027 and remediation notes
- Penetration test executive summary (latest) and mitigation tracker
- Encryption key management evidence (KMS rotation logs)

I will update the bridge letter draft to include the above and a short controls mapping. Expect draft v2 in ~18 hours for legal review. If procurement needs a signed interim attestation, Legal will need a day to sign once we finalize content.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jane.porter@finoptics.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 12:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report and audit window confirmation — FinOptics onboarding

Appreciate the quick triage. A couple tactical points from Sales/RevOps: 
- We should offer a short-term onboarding concession (one-time credit or SLA credit) if the bridge letter timeline pushes FinOptics' sign date beyond their internal cutoff. Use this as a negotiation lever, not a default.
- Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
  * 2027-06-08: Security provides bridge letter draft v2 + evidence bundle link
  * 2027-06-09: Legal signs interim attestation / finalizes wording (if acceptable)
  * 2027-06-10: FinOptics review deadline
  * 2027-06-14: Target signature / start onboarding (subject to acceptance)

Please confirm who will own the DocuSign flow and who will be the redwood signees (Legal or Security). Marcus, I can run pricing concession if Legal okays.

Marissa Cole
VP, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: Jane Porter <jane.porter@finoptics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report and audit window confirmation — FinOptics onboarding

Jane — quick update and proposed next steps:

Thanks for the note and timeline. We do not yet have a Type II that spans the full 2026-07-01 -> 2027-06-30 window; our latest published Type II covers 2026-01-01 -> 2026-12-31. To avoid delaying your rollout, Security has prepared a bridge letter and an evidence bundle for your review.

What I'm attaching now: bridge_letter_draft_v2.pdf (interim attestation draft), mutual_action_plan_finoptics.docx (summary of milestones), and a link to the evidence bundle in our secure Drive.

Proposed process:
1) Please review the attached bridge letter and evidence folder by 2027-06-10 EOD.
2) If acceptable, sign the DocuSign at: https://app.docusign.com/sign/FAKE-DOCUSIGN-FINOPTICS-8741 (placeholder link)
3) We will commit to delivering the next Type II report to your security team once finalized and will include the period requested. If the bridge letter requires legal sign-off on our side we will get Legal to countersign by 2027-06-11.

If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute call tomorrow morning to walk through the evidence and the controls mapping.

Thanks again — we want to get you onboarded without blocking the rollout.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
